headline: I guarantee improved power supply – Tinubu
summary: Nigerian President Bola Tinubu promised improved electricity supply. He said a deal with Yutong would reopen the Leyland factory in Ibadan, speaking at an APC campaign event in Oyo State.
why: Electricity reliability and manufacturing investment are key constraints on Nigeria's economy. Campaign pledges on these issues signal the policy direction ahead of the 2027 election.
